"""Bounded parser for the fourteen frozen Kotlin classes; reject unsupported SDK syntax."""
import re,collections

def expected_compiled_names(kotlin):
    class_prefix=kotlin.split('class ',1)[0]
    configs=re.findall(r'@Config\([^)]*sdk\s*=\s*\[([^]]+)\]',class_prefix)
    assert len(configs)==1, 'One explicit class SDK array required'
    def sdks(raw):
        assert re.fullmatch(r'\s*\d+(?:\s*,\s*\d+)*\s*',raw)
        values=[int(x)for x in raw.split(',')]
        assert values and len(values)==len(set(values))
        return values
    default=sdks(configs[0]);expected=[];methods=[]
    pattern=r'@Test\s*((?:@\w+(?:\([^)]*\))?\s*)*)fun\s+(\w+)\('
    for annotations,name in re.findall(pattern,kotlin):
        overrides=re.findall(r'sdk\s*=\s*\[([^]]+)\]',annotations)
        assert len(overrides)<=1
        selected=sdks(overrides[0])if overrides else default
        methods.append(name)
        expected.extend(name if sdk==max(selected) else f'{name}[{sdk}]' for sdk in selected)
    assert methods and len(methods)==len(set(methods))
    assert len(methods)==len(re.findall(r'@Test\b',kotlin)), 'Every test annotation must be parsed'
    return expected

def require_compiled_names(kotlin,compiled):
    expected=expected_compiled_names(kotlin)
    assert collections.Counter(compiled)==collections.Counter(expected), 'Missing, duplicate or unexpected SDK case'
    return expected
